_comment: UiPath Agent Builder configuration for Mopot. Defines the two Python agents as callable actions.

agent.name: Mopot Pipeline Agent
agent.description: Autonomous mobile test + fix pipeline — tests Flutter apps with Claude vision and opens fix PRs.

actions.name: Test App
actions.description: Navigate the running Flutter app via ADB, capture screenshots, and return a structured bug report.

output_schema.description: BugReport — see agents/tester_agent.py for full schema

actions.name: Fix Bugs
actions.description: Use Claude to write code fixes for each reported bug, commit to a branch, and open a GitHub PR.

_setup_instructions: 1. In UiPath Agent Builder, create a new agent and import this config
2. Set the working directory to the mopot project root
3. Map each credentials_required item to the corresponding Orchestrator asset
4. Test each action individually before connecting to the Maestro process
